title: D2 messaging error codes spec
description: Domain-specialized copy of contracts/error-codes/error-codes.canonical.schema.json, narrowed to the portable messaging catalog: the LIB_MESSAGING_* code-prefix regex (owner LIB, domain token MESSAGING), the [503] httpStatus subset, and the one category that status carries. Conforms to the canonical 7-field set (including factoryShape) but tightens the value constraints so editors catch a non-LIB_MESSAGING_ code, a non-503 status, or an out-of-set category at edit time. This is the source-of-truth catalog that DcsvIo.D2.Messaging.RabbitMq.ErrorCodes.SourceGen reads to emit MessagingErrorCodes.g.cs + MessagingTransportFailures.g.cs into DcsvIo.D2.Messaging.RabbitMq.

code.description: Wire-format error code (SCREAMING_SNAKE). Must be unique across the spec. The literal IS the wire format. Owner LIB, domain token MESSAGING - every code is LIB_MESSAGING_{REST}.

httpStatus.description: HTTP status mapping. Drives transport-side response shape. Every code in this catalog describes a transport that could not carry the message, so 503 is the only member; widening the set requires extending this enum AND the codegen mapping.

category.description: Closed semantic/telemetry classification. Every code in this catalog is a messaging-transport failure, so infrastructure_unavailable is the only member.

userMessageKey.description: Translation key reference rendered as the messages argument on the emitted D2Result factory (e.g. TK.Common.Errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE). The generator enforces existence by inverse-transforming the symbol path to the snake_case key (TK.Common.Errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE -> common_errors_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE) and asserting it is present in contracts/messages/en-US.json (D2ERC002). Codes in this catalog share the generic transport-unavailable key: the caller is told the service could not take the message, and the distinction between the transport failures is carried by the code and the operator-facing logs, not by the text a person reads.

factoryName.description: PascalCase symbol for the emitted factory method. It is the code with its LIB_MESSAGING_ prefix removed, rendered in Pascal case (LIB_MESSAGING_PUBLISH_UNROUTABLE -> PublishUnroutable). Must be unique across the spec.

factoryShape.description: Closed enum that drives the generated factory's signature variant. standard: the one universal error-factory shape (messages?, inputErrors?, errorCode?, category?, traceId?) - ALL optional; the errorCode / category overrides are how a delegating domain factory stamps a specific code + category on its base status. none: no factory generated for this code. Every messaging entry is standard.

doc.description: XML <summary> text rendered on the emitted constant + factory.

deprecated.description: When true, the entry is deprecated: the generated C# constant + factory carry [Obsolete] and the TS constant + factory carry @deprecated. Additive - the entry is NEVER deleted. Deleting a deprecated (or non-deprecated) entry is a breaking change the JSON-diff gate fails.

deprecatedReason.description: Plain dev-facing English explaining why the code is deprecated; rendered into the [Obsolete("...")] message, the @deprecated JSDoc, and the changelog entry. NOT a TK key (developer-facing, not user-facing).

replacedBy.description: Wire code of the successor entry (e.g. RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND). Must reference a real, non-deprecated entry in the merged registry. Omit for pure retirement with no replacement.

sunset.description: ISO-8601 date for the RFC 8594 Sunset response header. A host whose response pipeline emits that header reads the date from here; a host that does not ignores it.
